نستند (form VIII)
# نَسْتَنِدُ (nastanidu) /nas.ta.ni.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنَدَ (istanada)
# نَسْتَنِدَ (nastanida) /nas.ta.ni.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنَدَ (istanada)
# نَسْتَنِدْ (nastanid) /nas.ta.nid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنَدَ (istanada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
